component.name: Quick Settings
Configurações rápidas
Réglages rapides
component.summary: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, brightness, media and notifications in one panel applet
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, som, brilho, mídia e notificações num applet do painel
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, son, luminosité, médias et notifications dans une applet du panneau

description.p: A control center for the COSMIC™ panel, like the ones on Android, macOS and GNOME.

ul.li: Tiles for Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, Bluetooth, power mode, do not disturb (for an hour, until tomorrow…), dark style, airplane mode, tiling, accessibility and more, which you can add, remove, resize and drag around
Volume and brightness sliders, the volume of each app, and the sound output and microphone to use
What's playing, with its cover and controls, from any media player
Notifications, grouped by app, with their buttons
Indicators for apps using the camera or the microphone
The battery of the computer and of each wireless mouse, keyboard or headset on the panel
A DNS tile, to switch between the network's servers and Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or AdGuard
Choose which icons the panel shows, and how big they are
Settings opens from the Flatpak on systems without an X server
The battery icon follows the charge
Wi-Fi no longer shows as off while connected
The power button stays inside the popup with any interface density, and the notifications get room
Sliders and round buttons follow the theme's roundness
